'''Aaron Moore''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished Top Light Side (lost the final duel) at [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Clifton Park)]] on 24 June 2000, according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d928">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-death-star-ii-clifton-park-nyd928/ death-star-ii-clifton-park-ny], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-death-star-ii-clifton-park-nyd928/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
